03 / INFRASTRUCTURE

How often did Gemini time out?

Timeouts as a share of recorded attempts

Includes repeated watchdog attempts and multiple historical fingerprint groups. These are not independent API samples, SDK request counts, or an hourly outage rate.

How to interpret this

  • A timeout does not establish a library defect.
  • Older SDK-internal retries and failed-request token usage are unobserved.
  • A1 and A2 ran at different times with different documentation; the rates do not isolate the cause.
  • The repaired Thumbnailator worker logs a 630-second total deadline. Other loaded workers adopt it on their next launch.

Recorded provider failures typically took about 600 seconds; terminal outcomes were commonly tens of seconds.

05 / DATA & PROVENANCE

Inputs you can inspect

The harness also provides a synthetic 32×24 RGB image, a destination image, and an in-memory byte stream. Many constructors and getters need objects or scalar arguments rather than a dataset file.

Verified diagnostic observations

Separate source-informed probes, using the existing pinned JAR. They do not modify native scores or feed source hints into running audience tests.
Evidence hashes, reproduction, and limitations
Rebuild with build_review.py --a1-project … --a2-project … --out …, with the project’s grail-agent/src on PYTHONPATH. The HTML embeds all data and assets, makes no network requests, and does not refresh itself.
Source/code review supports the failure mechanism. A controlled counterfactual would be needed to establish that a specific README change caused a performance change. Missing historical evidence remains unknown.
